title: Dibujo y carta a Hoa Hakananaiʻa con una franja azul y amarilla, mostrados en Te Kuhane
author: Tamariki Rosas (lectura probable)

notes.text: A distinct sheet displayed sideways in the museum montage following the classroom invitation to draw and write to Hoa Hakananaiʻa. It combines a frontal moai, a narrow decorated form, a blue and yellow band and a Spanish letter addressed to the moai. Close views of the handwriting support the provisional reading Tamariki Rosas for the full signature and Tama for the shorter inscription. The attribution remains uncertain; no identity match to film participants or online profiles is asserted. The composition and letter belong to one source. The film's assignment and display sequence support the depicted-object link. The title is editorial. The representation is an unretouched film still at 00:25:04, retaining the original frame composition.
